subject.title: [Bug]: Skill Workshop agent-tool apply times out because approval wait exceeds tool watchdog

question: Should this issue be resolved by the broader approval-flow PR at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498 or by the narrower Codex watchdog PR at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91325?
rationale: Both open PRs close this issue, but the broader PR changes approval prompt semantics while the narrower PR only extends Codex watchdogs; selecting the canonical path is a maintainer security-boundary and release-scope choice.

options.title: Make The Broader Approval PR Canonical
options.body: Review and repair https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498 so it fixes the watchdog, metadata, and timeout-result problems together without weakening approval safety.

options.title: Land The Narrow Watchdog Fix
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91325 for this issue and leave popup metadata, revision binding, and timeout-result semantics to separate follow-ups.

options.title: Pause Both For Approval API Direction
options.body: Hold both PRs until approval owners settle the lifecycle approval contract and choose one permanent timeout boundary.

recommendation.title: Make The Broader Approval PR Canonical
recommendation.body: Review and repair https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498 so it fixes the watchdog, metadata, and timeout-result problems together without weakening approval safety.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned to this issue and owns the newer broader fix branch that currently competes with the older narrow PR.
